title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Business Systems
description:
Overview
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete AI Revenue Workflow Platform that helps sales leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. Outreach infuses agentic AI to power 100s of use cases across sales motions. From new logo prospecting to renewal and expansion, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Global organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including SAP, Siemens, Snowflake, ZoomInfo, and Verizon to name a few. To learn more, please visit .

About the Team

At Outreach, Business Systems’ mission is to enable and enhance corporate processes at scale. We are a centralized team providing a suite of services to other Outreachers, helping them to efficiently serve our customers and each other. We are building the team around strong critical thinkers - individuals who can navigate ambiguity and help us along our journey of discovery and transformation.

The Role

Outreach is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Business Systems team as a TPM aligned closely to our Finance systems portfolio. This role owns the strategy and execution across our end-to-end Finance technology stack, spanning ERP, procurement, expense management, and HR financial workflows.

The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise systems experience, strong cross-functional instincts, and the technical fluency to navigate integrations across a modern Finance tech stack.

You'll partner closely with Finance, Engineering, and Operations leadership to drive delivery, shape system strategy, and build durable program practices for a high-visibility portfolio.

Your Daily Adventures Will Include:

    • Own the TPM strategy for Outreach's Finance systems portfolio, serving as the primary program lead across ERP, procurement, expense, and financial operations tooling
    • Lead end-to-end program management for large-scale Finance system initiatives, including milestones, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication across Finance, Engineering, and Operations
    • Develop and execute project plans that span multiple teams and systems; proactively identify and resolve blockers across the full delivery lifecycle
    • Navigate shifting requirements and evolving business needs by refining scope, clarifying intent, and realigning delivery expectations with stakeholders
    • Drive UAT coordination with business stakeholders, ensuring readiness across Finance workflows before production deployment
    • Build and maintain program-level communication rhythms, tailored for both executive sponsors and cross-functional leads
    • Manage cross-functional delivery challenges with limited precedent; drive convergence in complex decision spaces involving Finance, IT, and external vendors
    • Establish and scale QA checkpoints, integration planning practices, and change management processes within the Finance systems portfolio
    • Advise on tooling decisions, integration strategy, and platform trade-offs across the Finance systems landscape
    • Informally guide TPM best practices across the team; contribute to cross-team execution frameworks and delivery culture

Our Vision of You:

    • 5+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 2 years on enterprise finance systems or ERP platforms
    • Demonstrated experience leading ERP migrations or large-scale system transitions (NetSuite, SAP, or equivalent)
    • Ability to manage shifting requirements across multi-stakeholder environments; experience aligning Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams around shared delivery goals
    • Strong understanding of enterprise system architecture, data flows, and integrations — able to translate business requirements into technical inputs and flag risks proactively
    • Experience coordinating UAT with business stakeholders and driving accountability across cross-functional teams
    • Familiarity with Finance-adjacent tools such as Concur, Workday, ZipHQ, or similar platforms is a strong plus
    • Proficient in defect/issue tracking tools such as Jira; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to clearly communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, up to executive level
    • Self-starter who identifies quality and delivery risks proactively, without waiting to be asked
    • Experience in a SaaS or high-growth technology environment preferred

Why You’ll Love It Here:

    • Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees and their dependents

    • Flexible time off

    • 401k to help you save for the future

    • Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military

    • A parental leave program that includes not just extended time off but options for a paid night nurse, and a gradual return to work

    • Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit

    • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

    • Plus, unlimited snacks and beverages in our kitchen

    • We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status

    Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

title: Senior Account & Project Manager (Advertising Agency)
description:
Oh, hello there, wearer of many hats.

Funday is a full service agency made up of people who are friendly and hardworking in equal measure. Inspired by an unrelenting belief that having fun is integral to creativity, we like to say we’re all about fun and brains. You know, that sweet spot between where pretty and performance meet and where insight and imagination produce the entirely unexpected? That’s where we thrive.

Senior Engagement Manager

We are looking for an experienced account manager who is also skilled in project management; this role is a hybrid, and we need someone who has a diverse skill set that bridges the project and account worlds. One minute you’ll discuss the details of a project’s deliverables with the creative team and the next, you’ll be talking budgets with your client. These roles aren’t always combined, but when they are, it’s pretty fun.

You will be expected to run your own account(s), and work with team members at all levels. Our clients and our team members are scattered around the globe. We’re a smaller group, so everyone gets their hands dirty. You’ll always be working with a team who has a passion for great work, including creatives, strategists and technologists who will help you push the work forward.

Location: You’ll work remotely from Toronto, Ontario.

What you’ll do

Account Management Responsibilities - A strong account manager takes the time to understand the client and their business and can even anticipate their needs. They are the bridge between the client and our internal team; they ensure clear communication between both sides and have the tough conversations when necessary.

  • Act as the primary contact for projects between the client, team, and vendors
  • Identify opportunities to deliver on client’s needs or to solve problems
  • Build positive working relationships with key client teams
  • Understand and anticipate clients’ short and long-term goals, as well as their competition
  • Manage issues in a professional and timely manner, finding solutions and consensus among all parties

Project Management Responsibilities - A strong project manager takes the time to understand what it is the client needs so they can take that information back to the team and communicate it in a way that they can easily get to creating the magic. They are very organized and scheduled but can stop everything and switch directions at the drop of a hat.

  • Ensure everything is in place to run and execute a project on time and within budget
  • Translate the clients’ needs into a language the team understands to get the work done
  • Conduct thorough scoping, planning, costing, and timing of projects
  • Oversee the entire delivery and execution process, ensuring and facilitating effective team communication and collaboration
  • Own, facilitate, document, and disseminate outcomes for meetings
  • Manage development priorities and timelines
  • Manage creative activities and client reviews
  • Communicate project status/risks to stakeholders
  • Identify, document, and communicate issues and changes that may affect the project

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Minimum 4-5 years recent experience in a marketing/advertising agency environment required, 5 - 7 years preferred
  • 6 - 8 years in an account management or project management role with at least 3 years experience in a hybrid accounts and project management role
  • Proven ability to move between the accounts and project worlds
  • Proven ability to grow client accounts
  • Experience working in an inter-agency setting is an asset
  • Adept at managing multiple clients and projects with heavily matrixed teams
  • Experience managing projects through the entire lifecycle, from planning to execution
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational and people management skills
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills
  • Flexibility when faced with changing priorities or circumstances
  • Experience with project management and issue tracking tools
  • Experience with budgeting and resource management
  • Experience managing project teams including deliverables, timelines, and internal prioritization
  • Experience managing all aspects of conversations with clients, including project intake, briefing, longer term planning, and challenging conversations
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members

You’ll want to read this part

  • Where you live & can work matters: If you live in Canada, are able to work here, and you are in Toronto, Ontario - please apply! Otherwise, we’re sorry, we’re not currently hiring for this role outside of that area.
  • This posting is for an existing vacancy we are looking to fill immediately and not a prospective future role (i.e. we’re saying this isn’t a ghost job).

Come be a Funatic

We believe you won’t perform at your best if you’re not having fun. And you can’t have fun if you’re not performing. We believe this creates the best client + agency relationships and is the best way to make great work.

We believe in respect, inclusivity, kindness, equity, and equality. We want to make a positive impact. We believe that collaboration is the fun part of being at work. We strive to create a culture in which “we” is more important than “me”.

Apart from loving terrible fun puns, we’re also 100% remote, and that might not appeal to everyone – but if you value flexibility, it’s perfect.

Join us.

Salary: $120,000 - $170,000 CAD

title: Data Engineer
description:
Description

Entrada AI, Inc. is looking for a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our growing team of consultants. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, constructing, and optimizing large-scale data processing systems that enable advanced analytics and business intelligence. You will collaborate closely with data scientists, analysts, and other engineers to ensure the availability, reliability, and efficiency of our client’s Databricks solution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust data pipelines that collect, process, and store large volumes of structured and unstructured data.

  • Architect and implement data warehouses, data lakes, and other storage solutions that support analytics and reporting needs.

  • Optimize data architectures and workflows for performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements and ensure that data systems meet their needs.

  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and security by implementing best practices in data governance and management.

  • Develop and maintain documentation for data systems, including data models, flow diagrams, and operational procedures.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in data engineering, and apply them to improve existing systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or related fields, with a focus on large-scale data systems

  • 2+ years of experience with Databricks

  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or NoSQL databases

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.

  • Experience with ETL tools and frameworks and data pipeline orchestration.

  • Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modeling, and schema design.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

title: Principal Product Manager - Steerage & Financial Incentives
description:
Come for the mission. Stay for the innovation.

Let's keep things simple: we are an unbelievably talented, hard-working, and compassionate team driving towards a mission that impacts every single one of us — even you.

Healthcare benefits are complex and largely underutilized by most people. That’s why HealthJoy was built with one vision: to remove the complexity from being healthy and well. We do that by guiding employees to affordable, high-quality healthcare, consolidating our clients’ health and wellness strategies into the HealthJoy Benefits Operating System - a simple, unified digital experience. The result: healthier employees and a healthier bottom line.

HealthJoy is at the forefront of using AI to transform the healthcare benefits industry. We're building intelligent platforms that use predictive analytics, natural language processing, and machine learning to guide employees to affordable, high-quality care. Our team is passionate about creating a more equitable and understandable benefits experience, while saving our clients time and money.

HealthJoy has garnered workplace awards from Inc.'s Fastest Growing Startups and Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work while growing globally to over 300 team members. We're continuing down the path of high growth and high impact — and this role is one of the most consequential bets we're making.

The Opportunity.

Healthcare costs are rising and employers are demanding real solutions with proven savings.

HealthJoy is extending its industry-leading engagement platform into a new product category that pairs financial incentives directly with our existing capabilities. The market for this model is validated and growing. Our position to win it is strong: years of member engagement data, deep integration across the benefits ecosystem, and infrastructure that standalone competitors can't replicate.

We're offering someone the chance to build a product line from scratch inside a company with real distribution, real data, and real backing. If you do it well — if the product is compliant, makes money, wins in the market, works for employers, and works for members — the natural next step is running it. The opportunity is for this role to grow into a General Manager position as the product scales.

Your Impact.

You are accountable for the success of this product as a business. That means it has to be compliant, financially sound, compelling to brokers and consultants, operationally deliverable for clients, and genuinely useful for members. All five. Not three of five.

You don't personally build everything that makes this product work. HealthJoy has teams and institutional knowledge across member experience, clinical programs, data science, and provider quality that will feed into this product. What you own is the product line itself — its architecture, commercial logic, compliance posture, market narrative, and outcomes. You know what each dependent capability needs to deliver for this product to win. You influence the teams that own those capabilities. You are accountable for the result regardless.

Stand the product up. Decide what we build, what we buy, and what we partner for. Evaluate and select the infrastructure partners that make the product work. Drive open questions and decisions across regulatory structure, financial model, and operational design. There is groundwork done, and many hard calls yet to be made.

Design the incentive and compliance architecture. Own the structure of how members are rewarded, what triggers reimbursement, and how the product stays compliant across a complex regulatory landscape. Work closely with legal and benefits counsel. Lead those conversations, don’t just receive them.

Make the financial model work. Understand the unit economics well enough to pressure-test them, represent them credibly to CFOs and benefits consultants, and know when the numbers are wrong. Collaborate with finance on underwriting assumptions and risk structure. You don't need to be an actuary. You need to be the person in the room who catches it when the model breaks.

Hold the behavior change layer accountable. Member behavior is what makes the financial model work. The teams and systems that drive that behavior already exist at HealthJoy. Your job is to define precisely what those capabilities need to accomplish for this product — which journeys matter, what influence looks like at the moments that count, how results get measured — and drive those outcomes through the teams that own them.

Build the GTM plan and the market narrative. Work with Product Marketing and Commercial to develop positioning, sales enablement, and the story that lands in the broker and consultant channel. You'll help write it. You'll need to be able to deliver it yourself.

Define and own the proof layer. Set the operational standards the product is held to. Own the ROI story that drives retention and expansion. Make sure the renewal conversation is about demonstrated value.

Influence crossfunctionally. This role is the connective tissue across a wide dependency set. You won't have formal authority over most of these teams. You will need enough credibility, clarity, and commercial conviction to lead them anyway. (Teams including Clinical Programs & Member Experience, Engineering & Data, Finance, Legal & Compliance, Network & External Partners, and Product Marketing & Sales.)

Your Experience.

We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been.

10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time operating at a senior or principal level. You’ve been the most senior PM on a product, not one of several with a Group Product Manager above you. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is expected; an MBA or background in healthcare, law, or finance is a plus, not a requirement.

Domain background that shortens the learning curve. Healthcare, benefits, insurance, or fintech experience is a real advantage here. The compliance and financial dimensions of this product have stakes and a learning curve that pure consumer or SaaS PM experience doesn't prepare you for.

A track record of standing things up. You've launched something that didn't exist before — with partner dependencies, regulatory constraints, and commercial pressure — and you own the full arc of what happened. Healthcare, benefits, or fintech experience is a meaningful advantage. The compliance and financial dimensions of this product have real stakes and the learning curve is real.

Business owner instincts, not feature owner instincts. You think in terms of whether the product makes money, wins in the market, and works for customers. You can hold the P&L logic and the product detail simultaneously without losing either.

Compliance-adjacent fluency. You don't need a JD. You need to be the kind of person who researches, forms a view, and leads the conversation with counsel — not the kind who waits for legal to tell you what's possible.

Financial modeling depth. You understand unit economics, can stress-test a pricing framework, and can explain the same financial story to a CFO and a benefits consultant in the same week without changing what you believe.

Organizational influence without authority. You've led outcomes across teams you don't manage. You know how to make people want to solve your problem without needing the org chart to back you up.

GTM instincts for channel-driven markets. You've launched products where the buyer isn't the end user and the channel has outsized influence on the sale. You know what brokers and consultants need to hear and how to build that into the product and the narrative.

AI fluency. You use AI tools to move faster across research, synthesis, spec drafting, and competitive analysis. You have a genuine point of view on how AI-powered personalization and recommendation should work in a regulated healthcare context.

Communication that's direct and calibrated. You can write a tight product brief and a compliance memo. You can present a pricing model to a CFO and a member journey to a clinical team.

This Role Is Not For Everyone

There is no established playbook for this product. The hard questions are real, and you'll be expected to drive them to decisions.

The cross-functional surface area is wide and formal authority is limited. You'll need to lead teams whose priorities you don't control toward outcomes you're accountable for. That's a different operating model than a traditional PM role.

If you do your best work when scope is clear, handoffs are defined, and someone else owns the hard calls — this isn't the job.

If building something consequential from scratch, inside a company with the assets to win, with a real path to running it as a business — sounds like exactly what you've been looking for — keep going.

Reporting & Growth Path

This role reports directly to the Chief Product Officer. You'll operate with significant autonomy and direct access to executive leadership, legal, finance, and commercial teams.

The growth path is explicit: as this product scales, this role is the natural foundation for a General Manager position with full P&L accountability. We're offering the chance to build toward that in a place where the distribution, data, and backing are already there.

We operate an open calendar policy: if you need time with someone, add it.

Total Rewards

Job Level: 50

Please email for salary inquiries.

HealthJoy maintains a comprehensive strategy to determine rewarding and competitive packages for individual compensation for new hires, internal promotions and internal job changes. This strategy is based on several factors unique to each individual, including: 1) the skills, experience and qualifications of the individual; 2) the responsibilities and demands of the role; 3) analysis of external market data; and 4) company budget and financial performance.

HealthJoy is a remote-first employer. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

At HealthJoy, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each role and individual.

In addition to cash compensation, HealthJoy offers a rich “Total Rewards” package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental and vision insurance packages
  • HSA contribution match
  • Stock options for eligible roles
  • 401k match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Company sponsored Short Term and Long Term Disability coverage
  • Flexible PTO

Commitment to Equal Pay

At HealthJoy, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and thrive.

We believe that everyone should be paid based on their qualifications, experience, and the work that they do, and not on their gender, race, or any other personal characteristic. Our compensation practices are essential to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where we value the contributions of all our employees.

We conduct thorough annual reviews of employee pay and our pay practices to ensure we reward the right behaviors and are providing equal pay for equal work.

Additionally, we assess the external market and internal equity across like roles. As part of our regular review of pay practices, HealthJoy examines employee pay for potential disparities between persons of different genders, races and ethnicities that are not explainable by objective factors such as performance, experience level, credentials, or location, and are committed to correcting any issues and reviewing practices from unintended outcomes.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

HealthJoy is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. HealthJoy is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role and HealthJoy, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Staff Endpoint Software Engineer - Python & OS Internals
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

At Prompt Security, our mission is to empower organizations to safely harness the transformative power of Generative AI. As a one-stop security platform, we provide visibility, governance, and real-time protection against all Generative AI concerns, enabling organizations to innovate and prosper in the age of AI without compromising on security.

As a Staff Endpoint Software Engineer, you'll build the lightweight security components that power our Generative AI Security platform - the core sensors and enforcement mechanisms that operate across endpoints, browsers, and production workloads to deliver real-time, adaptive protection. But building the technology is only half the job. We're looking for an engineer who understands why we're building it: someone fluent in our product, our roadmap, and the real GenAI risks our customers face every day - and who treats a customer problem as their own until it's solved.

You'll own your work end-to-end, engage directly with the realities of how customers deploy and rely on our sensors, and diagnose and fix issues on the fly when it matters. You'll collaborate with expert engineers on high-impact GenAI security challenges while growing your expertise and your influence on where the product goes next.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Build and optimize sensor components for minimal system footprint - high performance, low resource consumption, and maximum reliability across diverse customer environments.
  • Evolve our Agentic AI capabilities by helping design adaptive policy logic, improving decision engines, and expanding coverage across platforms - grounded in real customer use cases and roadmap priorities.
  • Build endpoint and browser security components and integrate them into the platform for real-time GenAI threat detection and data protection (prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, shadow AI, and more).
  • Own customer-facing technical problems end-to-end - investigate production issues, reproduce and fix them quickly under real-world pressure, and follow through until the customer is unblocked.
  • Translate business and roadmap context into engineering decisions - understand what customers need, where the product is heading, and why, so your technical choices move the business forward.
  • Collaborate across security engineering, QA, product, and customer-facing teams to hit customer and business goals - not just ship code.
  • Stay current with GenAI and platform security and fold relevant advances into our sensors, agents, and extensions.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • At least 6 years of experience in Python, Node.js, or a comparable language
  • Experience with macOS and Windows Endpoint Security
  • Proficiency in OS architecture and internals
  • Strong customer orientation - you take ownership of customer problems and can diagnose and fix issues on the fly in real-world conditions
  • Business and product awareness - genuine interest in the roadmap, the market, and the customers we serve, and the judgment to weigh technical decisions against business impact
  • Accountability and growth mindset - you own your outcomes, hold yourself to a high bar, and actively invest in your own and the team's growth
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Proficiency in browser extension development (Chrome, Firefox, etc.) - Advantage

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

$156,000—$215,000 USD

title: Product Owner
description:
About YSI

Yellow Social Interactive is a dynamic and innovative leader in the social gaming industry, dedicated to creating engaging and interactive experiences across various platforms. Our commitment to excellence and creativity sets us apart in the market.

We seek exceptional, talented individuals who aim for excellence. With offices in Gibraltar, Antigua, and bases in Malta and the Philippines, plus a global remote team, we welcome motivated people capable of building and scaling business functions.

Job Purpose

As a Product Owner, you will own one or more strategic platform capabilities, ensuring they continuously deliver value for the business, our customers and our operational teams. You will define and maintain the vision and roadmap for your areas, translating commercial objectives, customer needs and operational requirements into clear product direction and well-prioritized, delivery-ready work for Engineering.

Working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and the wider business, you will ensure strong alignment between stakeholders, maintain clarity of priorities and support effective delivery through structured backlog management and consistent decision-making. You will also play a key role in strengthening Product ways of working, improving governance and ensuring Engineering can focus on building high-quality solutions with confidence in what is being delivered and why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you will help shape how Product operates as the organization evolves, contributing to a more scalable, consistent and value-driven Product function that supports long-term growth.

Areas of Responsibility

Product Ownership

  • Own the roadmap and ongoing evolution of assigned capabilities.
  • Balance business value, customer needs and technical considerations when making prioritisation decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
  • Maintain ownership throughout the complete product lifecycle.

Product Delivery

  • Maintain a healthy, prioritised and delivery-ready backlog.
  • Translate business needs into clear functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support Engineering throughout development by providing timely clarification and decision making.
  • Validate delivered solutions against agreed business objectives.
  • Coordinate with QA to ensure successful business acceptance before release.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Facilitate workshops and requirement gathering sessions.
  • Communicate priorities, trade-offs and delivery expectations clearly.
  • Build alignment between Product, Engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Encourage collaborative decision making based on evidence and business value.

Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor product performance and adoption.
  • Use operational insight, player feedback and data to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to the development of Product standards, governance and best practices.
  • Support the ongoing maturity of the Product organisation.

Requirements

Essential

  • Significant experience as a Product Owner role within software or digital platforms.
  • Proven experience working closely with Engineering teams.
  • Strong project, backlog management and prioritisation skills.
  • Experience translating business requirements into clear product requirements.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience delivering complex software products within Agile environments.

Desirable

  • Platform product experience.
  • Payments, Wallet or Financial Platform experience.
  • Social Casino, Gaming or regulated industry experience.
  • Experience supporting organisational or platform transformation.
  • Experience working across multiple brands or markets.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Performance Bonus
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Opportunities for career growth and development.
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

In the near term, you’ll spend most of your time in our Shopify + Hydrogen e-commerce website, building and iterating and running experiments. Over time, we expect the work to shift: roughly 70% in our React Native mobile and web app, 30% in the e-comm site. This is a role that will grow and evolve as the Pod does.

Our ideal candidate is a versatile frontend engineer with deep experience in Typescript and React and/or React Native, who is equally comfortable reasoning about business outcomes as they are writing clean, well-tested code. You care deeply about how your work moves the needle, not just whether it shipped. And you bring rigor to experimentation: designing tests carefully, interpreting results honestly, and building experiences that real families will encounter every day.

Your title and compensation will be determined by your experience and expertise. Our bottom-line requirements are a strong foundation in Typescript, React, A/B testing, and analytics along with a genuine interest in growth and experimentation, and a drive to deliver outcomes that matter to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and iterate on experiments across our e-commerce site and mobile/web app to improve subscription attach rate, retention, and other growth metrics.
  • Implement new features and UI flows in our Shopify + Hydrogen e-comm site and our React Native app with a high bar for quality and user experience.
  • Help evaluate, implement, and configure the A/B testing and experimentation tools the Growth Pod adopts.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and growth-focused cross-functional partners to move quickly from hypothesis to live test.
  • Write high-quality, reusable, and maintainable code, and contribute to a comprehensive test suite to ensure stability as we ship fast.
  • Participate in code reviews and bring constructive, thoughtful feedback to elevate the team’s work.
  • Help establish processes for monitoring performance and tracking experiment results and health metrics.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience (5+ years) with Typescript and React, with meaningful production work in React Native and/or a modern e-commerce frontend stack. Experience with Shopify (and especially with Hydrogen) would be amazing.
  • Genuine interest in growth engineering. You want to understand why users convert (or don’t), and you care about the business outcomes your code produces.
  • Comfort with A/B testing concepts and a respect for statistical rigor. You know the difference between a result and a fluke.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture and design patterns, with a high bar for code quality and user experience.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills. You can work fluidly with Product, Design, and Data, and you’re comfortable operating with autonomy on a small, scrappy team.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Except November & December)

title: VSP Physician Collaborator
description:
Become a part of our caring community

We are excited to offer the role of Virtual Physician Collaborator for CenterWell Medical Group, a new virtual care delivery group within CenterWell Senior Primary Care, Humana's Primary Care Organization.

This group will provide virtual wraparound services to support patients when they cannot get in with their own PCP – closing gaps in care, ensuring timeless access to important medications and solving urgent clinical needs.

This Virtual Physician Collaborator shares in our vision to improve primary care for the next generation of seniors and is eager to support excellent care every day! As the Physician Collaborator, you will focus on the collaborative relationship through our Nurse Practitioners. This is a fully remote role, which involves approximately 5 hours a month.

You will work in a remote role, reporting to our Associate Director.

Responsibilities

  • You will complete regular chart review and coordinate monthly meetings
  • You will be available as a resource for the advanced practice provider to ensure quality patient care.
  • You will collaborate with clinical leaders about quality of care, review of outcome data, procedure, and records issues.

Required Qualifications:

  • You will have a current and unrestricted medical license in the state of Mississippi
  • You must actively practice medicine in the state of Mississippi in a physical capacity
  • You will be a graduate of accredited MD or DO program of accredited university
  • You are Board certification or Board Eligible
  • You will have 2+ years telemedicine/telehealth experience
  • You will have 2+ years of experience as a Collaborating Physician


Use your skills to make an impact

Additional Information

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers benefits for limited term, variable schedule and per diem associates which are designed to support whole-person well-being. About us

About CenterWell Senior Primary Care: CenterWell Senior Primary Care provides proactive, preventive care to seniors, including wellness visits, physical exams, chronic condition management, screenings, minor injury treatment and more. Our unique care model focuses on personalized experiences, taking time to listen, learn and address the factors that impact patient well-being. Our integrated care teams, which include physicians, nurses, behavioral health specialists and more, spend up to 50 percent more time with patients, providing compassionate, personalized care that brings better health outcomes. We go beyond physical health by also addressing other factors that can impact a patient’s well-being.About CenterWell, a Humana company: CenterWell is a leading healthcare services business focused on creating integrated and differentiated experiences that put our patients at the center of everything we do. The result is high-quality healthcare that is accessible, comprehensive and, most of all, personalized. As the largest provider of senior-focused primary care, a leading provider of home healthcare and a leading integrated home delivery, specialty, hospice and retail pharmacy, CenterWell is focused on whole health and addressing the physical, emotional and social wellness of our patients. CenterWell is part of Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM). Learn more about what we offer at CenterWell.com.

description:
Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming the health care experience and providing access to world-class health care in America’s heartland.

Work Shift:

8 Hours - Day Shifts (United States of America)

Union Position:

Department Details

Summary

Reviews inpatient clinical documentation, procedural information, and diagnostic results to apply ICD-10-CM and PCS diagnostic and procedural codes used for billing, internal and external data reporting, research, regulatory compliance, and quality monitoring.

Job Description

Using professional coding training, critical thinking, and clinical acumen, accurately assigns ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes to conditions and procedures documented within the inpatient electronic medical record. Applies Official Coding Guidelines, CMS regulations/guidelines, and other coding standards and guidelines established for use with the ICD-10 standard code set. Responsible to maintain quality and productivity standards and guidelines as set by the organization. Remains up-to-date on ICD-10-CM and PCS coding principles, governmental regulations, official coding guidelines and third-party payer requirements as they relate to compliant documentation, billing and coding practices. Strong knowledge of MS-DRGs and APR-DRGs. Works collaboratively with providers and departments such as clinical documentation improvement and quality to standardize and enhance coding, documentation, and quality reporting related practices. Works with a variety of software solutions in the performance of daily work. Flexible and a strong commitment to team where staff and leaders work together across great distances, most often in a home-based work setting.

Qualifications

Associate degree in Health Information Technology (or eligible) or Bachelors degree in Health Information Management and/or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) required.

Previous hospital coding experience highly desirable. Prior computer and/or encoder software experience desirable.

Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) required. New graduates eligible for certification must complete the certification examination at the earliest testing dates following employment, and all subsequent dates thereafter until the exam is satisfactorily completed. If the individual fails the exam two consecutive times, there will be an evaluation by the Department Director who will determine one of the following: (A) Continue employment if overall job performance is satisfactory. If the employee is allowed to continue employment, failure to pass the exam on the third opportunity will result in immediate termination. (B) If performance is not satisfactory, the employee may be terminated.

title: Integrated Client Solutions Director
description:
WHO WE ARE

At Basis, we empower agencies and brands with cutting-edge software that automates digital media operations. Our all-in-one platform supports seamless planning, reporting, and financial reconciliation across direct, programmatic, search, and social media.
We’re not just building advanced technology; we’re also building a culture where passionate, motivated individuals come together to drive meaningful change. Our commitment to inclusivity and growth ensures our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
With our headquarters in Chicago, we offer flexible work options across the U.S. and Canada, including remote, hybrid, or on-site at headquarters.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Integrated Client Solutions (ICS) team provides strategic partnership and integrated media solutions to our diverse suite of clients. We deliver Raving Fan Service by helping clients challenge their media objectives and realize their business ambitions. Powered by best-in-class research and planning tools, ICS works in partnership with our sales team to tailor our tech enabled services approach to drive better outcomes and media campaigns.

WAYS YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE

This position will be responsible for acting as the key client contact for a suite of Basis clients. As the Integrated Client Solutions Director, you will be responsible for continually advancing the quality of work across your accounts. You will contribute by:

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

    • Min of 8 years of experience in digital media planning and buying, including site direct and programmatic or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience, etc.

    • Experience in Pharma marketing is required, both client leadership experience and experience with media buying within the vertical.

    • Holistic understanding of the digital media landscape including search, social, and programmatic

    • Strong written and verbal communication

    • Curiosity and passion for advertising

    • Strategic thinking and proactive client servicing skills

    • Strong issue resolution and problem-solving capabilities

    • Ability to work well in a cross functional team environment

    • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skill set

    • Commitment to creating inclusive, respectful environments where all voices are valued and supported.

    • Thoughtful approach to collaboration, design, and decision-making that prioritizes equity, access, and continuous learning.

BONUS POINTS

    • Pharma experience preferred

    • Prior experience at a SaaS organization

    • Hands on DSP buying experience

    • Experience working with a 3rd party ad server

    • Experience in digital reporting dashboards such as Datorama

    • Experience in search and social media

    • Basis Certified

Integrity in Hiring

At Basis, integrity is at the core of how we hire. To protect our candidates and our company, we verify identity, education, and employment history for all hires. Some roles may also require onsite or in-person interviews as part of the process. Any misrepresentation of identity, experience, or skills may result in removal from the hiring process or termination of employment. We value transparency and authenticity and expect the same from every applicant.

Anything Else?

Don’t have every skill listed? No problem! We know experience can be built in many ways. If you have relevant skills that aren't reflected in your resume, we encourage you to share them in an optional cover letter.

Life With Basis

We’re committed to our people’s growth and well-being because our success is tied to theirs. That’s why we’ve earned recognition as a top workplace, including: Ad Age, #1 Best Places to Work, WorkLife's #1 Most Committed to Work Life Balance, and the Chicago Tribune's Top Workplaces in Chicago. We offer competitive perks, including a flexible work week, 401k/RRSP matching, mental health support, paid sabbaticals, generous parental leave, flexible work options, and more.
Basis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate all team members regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, disability, age, and beyond.
If you need assistance with interview accessibility, please contact @basis.com. Your privacy is important to us, view our policy here.

title: Dorothy Comfort- Senior Analyst
description:
Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

The Dorothy Comfort Senior Analyst provides EHR design, build, testing and advanced troubleshooting services for Nordic’s more complex clients. They bring strong technical and soft skills. They perform most of the day-to-day work for our clients with oversight and assistance from Application Advisors and Senior Application Advisors.

They will be responsible for, but not be limited to:

Technical

  • Performing advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving within their application to ensure the integrity, integration, and stability of EHR applications for Nordic’s complex customers

  • Fulfilling system requests from customers by performing issue analysis within their application, translating needs into detailed requirement specifications, and performing system build and testing

  • Performing analysis of workflows system setup, and system audits, including participating in system upgrades and testing

Project and Issue Management

  • Exercising moderate judgment and contributing to decisions, under the supervision of Application Advisors, in support of Managed Services customers that could have impacts to patient safety, financial integrity, and regulatory compliance; contributing to decisions regarding what escalation is appropriate

  • Managing multiple customer assignments with minimal oversight from Application Advisors, including awareness of unique customer build and process, management of open issues in a ticketing system, email communication, and calendar management

  • Managing multiple complex clients and projects simultaneously with minimal oversight from Application Advisors, including maintaining awareness of unique customer build and process, managing open issues in a ticketing system, and monitoring customer specific email and calendar

  • Accurately completing up-to-date documentation in relevant ticketing system(s), regarding requests processed and incidents solved while still meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

  • Following proper change control policies for migrating application build and configurations

  • Working on projects that may be assigned on an ad hoc basis, and assisting in other internal initiatives as necessary, directed, assigned, or requested

Teamwork and Customer Service

  • Providing outstanding customer service by anticipating and meeting shifting customer needs, and delivering high quality support, and valuing and building relationships with customer IT and operations staff, including customer end-users, operations managers, IT analysts, and IT managers

  • Participating in communication and change-management of proposed changes, ensuring concerns and input from affected groups are addressed, and system changes are understood and properly used

  • Contributing to a supportive team culture where everyone is focused on the overall goals of Managed Services; Adapting their own focuses of time and energy, under the guidance of Managers and Application Advisors, to deliver on most-important priorities

  • Assisting in the onboarding of new team members to customer support team, including orienting to unique client configuration and processes, and introducing employees to customer counterparts

Growth and Mentorship

  • Understanding complex system setup, and able to explain and communicate that setup in ways that are easy to understand for internal staff and day-to-day customer counterparts

  • Taking on new responsibilities and challenges to continually grow and develop skills to meet the evolving needs of Managed Services and our customers

  • Seeking opportunities to delegate and explain less complicated tasks to peers and less-experienced team members; guiding and overseeing the completion of delegated tasks

Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (relevant education and/or 8+ years’ industry experience).

  • Epic Certification in Dorothy Comfort with strong understanding of functionality within that application

  • 3-5+ year of experience implementing, training, or supporting EHR modules

  • Must demonstrate and embody Nordic’s maxims

  • Ability to apply problem solving skills

  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to organize

  • Must be able to work independently, as well as within a team environment

  • Prior experience with ticketing systems and change management processes

  • Strong customer service track record

  • Knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes, previous management and project management experience, and participation in previous systems implementations, preferred

Additional Details

  • Ability to take on-call rotations outside of core business hours, including nights and weekends

  • Ability to travel up to 10%

Build your future with us

Cincinnati Re is seeking a talented Reinsurance Analytics Developer to enhance rating tools, data analytics, and reporting. This role focuses on refining reinsurance pricing models, streamlining actuarial processes, and collaborating across teams to support data-driven underwriting decisions.

  • collaborate with catastrophe modeling, portfolio management, and underwriting teams to support reinsurance analytics strategies
  • stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in modeling and reinsurance

  • occasional travel for internal meetings (about 8 trips a year)

Be equipped with:

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in actuarial, reinsurance, or insurance analytics

title: Senior UX Strategist
description:
Compensation Range:

Annual Salary: $78,496.00 - $105,974.00

Position Summary

The Senior UX Strategist is responsible for shaping and optimizing end-to-end customer experiences across the prospective student journey through research, journey strategy, customer discovery, service design, and innovation. This role leads user research, journey mapping, design thinking, and requirements gathering to uncover customer needs, identify experience opportunities, and translate insights into actionable strategies and scalable solutions.

Working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Analytics, Marketing, and Technology teams. The Senior UX Strategist drives alignment, influences decision-making, and helps create customer-centered digital experiences that improve engagement, conversion, and overall user outcomes.

Essential Functions:

Experience Strategy & Journey Mapping

  • Lead end-to-end prospective student journey mapping, service blueprinting, and experience strategy initiatives across National University's digital ecosystem.
  • Define current-state and future-state prospective student journeys, identifying friction points, unmet needs, moments that matter, and opportunities to improve engagement, inquiry, application progression, and enrollment outcomes.
  • Translate prospective student insights, institutional priorities, and business objectives into experience strategies, journey roadmaps, and prioritized recommendations that influence digital product and UX roadmaps.
  • Develop experience frameworks, journey principles, and future-state vision artifacts that guide customer-centered digital experiences across the prospective student lifecycle.
  • Partner with Marketing, Enrollment, Product, and Digital teams to align prospective student journey priorities with institutional goals and long-term digital strategy.

User Research & Discovery

  • Develop and own the UX research strategy and roadmap supporting prospective student experience initiatives.
  • Lead and execute qualitative and quantitative research, including stakeholder interviews, prospective student interviews, usability testing, surveys, concept validation, diary studies, and behavioral research.
  • Synthesize customer insights, behavioral analytics, market research, competitive analysis, and voice-of-the-customer findings into strategic recommendations that shape experience strategy and digital priorities.
  • Establish and mature UX research standards, repositories, tools, governance, and knowledge-sharing practices that strengthen organizational understanding of prospective student behaviors and needs.
  • Manage research vendors, participant recruitment, research operations, budgets, and external partnerships to ensure high-quality research execution.
  • Partner with the Digital Analytics team to combine qualitative and quantitative insights into a comprehensive understanding of prospective student behaviors, motivations, and decision-making.

Innovation, Ideation & Experience Planning

  • Lead design thinking workshops, customer journey workshops, ideation sessions, and cross-functional innovation initiatives focused on improving the prospective student experience.
  • Facilitate collaborative discovery sessions with Product, Marketing, Engineering, Analytics, Enrollment, and Content teams to identify customer needs, define opportunities, and align on future-state experiences.
  • Gather, synthesize, and prioritize business, customer, and technical requirements, translating findings into strategic experience recommendations, opportunity assessments, and implementation-ready requirements.
  • Develop future-state journey concepts, service blueprints, experience frameworks, and innovation proposals that improve prospective student engagement and enrollment outcomes.
  • Research emerging trends in customer experience, AI, higher education, and digital innovation to identify new opportunities that strengthen National University's prospective student experience.
  • Influence digital product and experience roadmaps by advocating for prospective student needs, journey improvements, and evidence-based experience decisions.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Individual contributor role that provides leadership through influence and expertise; scope may evolve over time based on organizational needs.

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. Master’s degree or M.B.A. preferred.
  • 6 -8 years of experience in UX Strategy, UX Research, Service Design, Customer Experience, or Product Discovery.
  • Experience leading journey mapping, customer research, design thinking workshops, requirements gathering, and cross-functional facilitation.
  • Experience managing research vendors and UX research platforms.
  • Experience designing for higher education, edtech, or other multi-audience environments preferred.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered design across complex digital ecosystems.

Competencies/Technical/Functional Skills:

  • Deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, customer discovery, experience strategy, and human-centered design principles.
  • Strong experience translating customer insights, behavioral data, and business objectives into strategic recommendations, journey roadmaps, and experience investments.
  • Advanced facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead workshops, align diverse perspectives, and build consensus across complex organizations.
  • Expertise in journey mapping, service blueprinting, experience ecosystems, design thinking, and innovation frameworks.
  • Ability to synthesize customer research, market intelligence, competitive analysis, and business priorities into actionable strategies that influence product, marketing, enrollment, and digital experience decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams through customer insights, strategic thinking, and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Experience developing future-state vision artifacts, experience principles, opportunity frameworks, and strategic roadmaps that guide organizational decision-making.
  • Familiarity with UX research platforms and collaboration tools (User Testing, Userlytics, Dovetail, Miro, Figma, Qualtrics, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, conversion optimization, and data-informed experience design practices.
  • Solid understanding of accessibility (WCAG), responsive design principles, content strategy, and digital experience best practices.
  • Exposure to AI, personalization, emerging technologies, and digital innovation trends, with the ability to evaluate their impact on customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term vision, customer needs, organizational objectives, and execution realities.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, lead through influence, navigate ambiguity, and build strong partnerships across a diverse and matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated commitment to accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer-centered decision-making.

Location: Remote, USA

Travel: up to 10% travel

Job Summary
We are seeking an Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Developer to build and maintain enterprise-grade digital experiences on AEM Sites, AEM Assets, and AEM as a Cloud Service.   • Collaborate with content authors, designers, and product owners on authoring experience improvements.
  • Stay current with AEM releases, Cloud Service evolution, and Adobe ecosystem developments.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of AEM development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Java, OSGi, Sling, and HTL.
  • Strong understanding of AEM architecture including author, publish, and Dispatcher tiers.
  • Hands-on experience with AEM as a Cloud Service or AEM 6.5.

  • Strong front-end skills with modern JavaScript and build tools.

  • Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Adobe Certified AEM Developer credentials.
  • Experience with Edge Delivery Services and Franklin/HLX.

About the role and team

  • Improve stakeholder collaboration & influence

  • Partner with engineering, operations, and business teams to foster a security-first culture.

title: Projects Geotechnical Engineer
description:
VACANCY ADVERTISEMENT: PROJECTS GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEER

Lumwana Mining Company seeks to recruit a highly motivated and committed individual for the position of Projects Geotechnical Engineer to join our Mineral Resources Management team. We are in search of individuals who can champion Barrick's DNA by:

  • Communicating Honestly, Transparently, and Acting with Integrity

  • Exhibiting a Results-Driven approach

  • Delivering solutions that are Fit for Purpose

  • Dedicating themselves to Building a Sustainable Legacy

  • Taking Responsibility and being Accountable

  • Committing to Zero Harm

  • Cultivating strong and meaningful Partnerships

Reporting to the Senior Geotechnical Engineer, you will be responsible for leading the junior Geotechnical Engineers in delivering a full spectrum of geotechnical work spanning field data collection and technical analysis. This includes geotechnical drilling supervision, core and soil logging, televiewer survey management, rock mass characterization, structural data interpretation, geotechnical block modelling, and slope stability assessment.

Your duties will include but are not limited to the following:

  • Supervise geotechnical investigation drilling programs, ensuring high-quality core recovery with accurate and consistent orientation markings that meet project standards.

  • Ensure drilling sites are prepared in advance of drilling and all requirements for each drill site are in place

  • Carry out lithological and structural logging of geological and geotechnical exploration holes on the drilling site or in the core shed.

  • Ensure the core is properly secured and transported to the core shed for storage ore further processing

  • Carry out point load testing on core pieces, ensuring test procedures and data recording meet required standards.

  • Ensure that core samples for rock strength testing are selected and well preserved in readiness for shipping to the Labs for testing.

  • Accurately and timeously enter all geotechnical logging data into the project geotechnical database, ensuring completeness, consistency, and compliance with data entry protocols

  • Conduct regular data validation and quality checks to identify and resolve errors or inconsistencies in logged and entered data

  • Maintain organised and up-to-date records of all field data, test results, sample registers, and drilling reports

  • Continually improve their geotechnical skills by way of working through the geotechnical skills matrix and seeking guidance and mentorship from the Geotechnical Coordinator.

  • Carry out rock mass characterisation from logging data, including calculation and interpretation of geotechnical indices such as RQD, RMR, Q-system, and GSI

  • Perform structural data interpretation and analysis using Dips software, including stereonet analysis, kinematic failure assessments, and identification of critical structural domains

  • Develop and update geotechnical block models integrating logging data, laboratory test results, and structural interpretations to support mine design and planning

  • Contribute to slope stability assessments and building stability models, providing well-reasoned geotechnical recommendations based on field and analytical data

  • Assist the Senior Geotechnical Engineer in the preparation of geotechnical reports, data summaries, and technical memoranda for various stages of project development

  • Provide mentorship to the junior geotechnical engineers

To be considered for the position, you must meet the following requirements:

  • Full Grade 12 School Certificate

  • Degree in Mining Engineering or Geology

  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in the Mining industry

  • Proven experience with geology or geotechnical logging

  • Good computer skills with ability to use integrated management systems, word processing, presentations and spreadsheet applications

  • Strong communication, leadership, and safety management skills.

  • Must be a member of Engineering Institute of Zambia (EIZ)

title: Image Collection Specialist (Russia)
description:
About the Role

Are you detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and interested in helping train the next generation of Artificial Intelligence? RWS is seeking Image Collection Specialists based in Russia to participate in a large-scale data collection project.

In this role, you will collect and submit high-quality, real-world images of everyday items, documents, and environmental signs using our proprietary mobile tool. Your contributions will directly improve OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technologies and multimodal AI models.

Job Type: Freelance
Location: Ukraine (work from home)
Work Schedule: Part-time - 10+ hours per week. Flexible - work whenever you want.
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: TBC
Rate: 6 USD per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Image Collection: Locate and capture real-world, original photos across 14 predefined everyday and enterprise categories.

  • Category Coverage: Your collection will span diverse categories, including:

    • Commercial/Daily Life: Price tags, small menus, product labels, receipts, and warning signs (on packaging, food, etc.).

    • Environmental: Signs, billboards, and bus stop boards.

    • Business/Technical: Documents (reports, investor materials), forms, memos & notes, notices, graphs (pie charts, bar charts), and workflows/figures.

  • Metadata/Annotation (Potential): Future project phases may require adding basic captions or performing simple OCR transcriptions of the captured text.

What we’re looking for:

  • Must be currently living in Russia.

  • Native-level written and spoken fluency in Russian.

  • Access to a smartphone with a high-quality camera and a stable internet connection.

  • Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.

Important Banking Eligibility: Due to current international banking restrictions, all candidates based in sanctioned regions must have a bank account registered in a country outside sanctioned regions to receive international payments.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

title: Commercial Learning Lead
description:
About This Role:
As the Commercial Learning Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the commercial capability strategy within our organization. You will partner with Commercial Leadership to translate business priorities into scalable learning and performance solutions that enhance field execution and drive impactful business results. You will be integral in defining and executing a comprehensive learning strategy that supports launch readiness, strengthens field effectiveness, and adapts to market dynamics. As a trusted advisor, you will leverage data and industry best practices to create innovative learning ecosystems that combine traditional and digital approaches, ensuring organizational efficiency.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the development and execution of a strategic learning plan aligned with commercial objectives and franchise priorities.
  • Serve as the senior learning advisor to Commercial Leadership, impacting field effectiveness and business performance.
  • Establish a capability roadmap to advance product knowledge, selling skills, and customer engagement excellence.
  • Provide oversight for onboarding, continuous development, and launch readiness across field teams.
  • Build executive-level partnerships and influence organizational priorities to drive strategic initiatives.
  • Champion a culture of continuous learning and performance excellence across commercial teams.
  • Design and implement innovative learning solutions that enhance performance and time-to-productivity.
  • Utilize performance consulting methodologies to assess challenges and identify interventions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop high-performing learning professionals fostering collaboration and innovation.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business priorities and compliance standards.

Who You Are:
You are a strategic thinker with a passion for learning and development. You thrive on building partnerships and influencing senior leaders to drive impactful business results. You excel in translating complex challenges into innovative solutions and are committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You are adaptable, forward-thinking, and dedicated to enhancing organizational readiness through strategic capability-building solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree required: advanced degree preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, healthcare, or related commercial roles.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience in commercial learning and talent development.
  • Proven track record in product launch and launch readiness leadership.
  • Expertise in performance consulting, instructional design, and capability development methodologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience translating data into strategic recommendations.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in Specialty, Immunology, or complex therapeutic areas.
  • Experience with AI-enabled learning and performance support solutions.
  • Success in building scalable capability models across franchises or customer-facing functions.
  • Leadership in field effectiveness, account management, or commercial excellence initiatives.
